fusions.name: Feigned Rear
fusions.desc: You rear and wheel through up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and knocking them back 2 tiles, then turn them against each other for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Blind-Side Kick
fusions.desc: A kick from behind at a target at or below 25% health that deals 20 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.4 times their remaining damage. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: False Tracks
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and you move 20% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Made a Fool Of
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a kick strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
